title: Nien Numb
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: Hailing from the planet Sullust -where the Rebellion massed their fleet in the lead up to the Battle of Endor- Nien Nunb was selected to be Lando Calrissian's co-pilot in the Millennium Falcon for the assault on Endor. He kept a cool head and wry tone as he went on what very well could have been a suicide mission. He'd sign up for more, working with the Resistance against the First Order, too.
